segmented-final product SysEx reloads selected record through 0x02005660

single-parameter index is truncated to 8 bits

non_sender_reason: The only normal-firmware raw writer is stock UI SAVE, which is not host-addressed or readback-guarded in the exact v15 evidence.

normal_firmware_capability.combined_manual_sequence: Bank D slot selected on UI -> product SysEx -> optional single-parameter 0x9b playback-note byte -> press stock SAVE before changing selection should seed the raw prefix through normal firmware
normal_firmware_capability.product_sysex_alone: does not write raw 0xa3 records; it stages 0x9c bytes, calls 0x0201e13e, writes selected packed 0x80 record, then reloads selected current snapshot
normal_firmware_capability.single_parameter_sysex: can write one byte in current snapshot, including index 0x9b via F0 43 10 01 1B dd F7, but it is volatile until SAVE
normal_firmware_capability.stock_ui_save: can write the selected raw 0xa3 record and therefore can write record indices 96..111 when Bank D presets 1..16 are selected

snippets: `0x0201e468` and `0x0201e49c` are the two official v15 calls from the SysEx handler to `0x0201e13e`.
`0x0201e13e` consumes the expanded single-voice source pointer in `r0`, packs it into a stack `0x80` buffer

scope: official v15 product SysEx and stock UI/SAVE only; no v12 assumptions; no live device access
